metadata.name: Cloud investigation layer example
metadata.scope: Fictional vendor and organization graph layers; no incident data or execution.

metadata.name: Example vendor · cloud audit v1.1
metadata.description: Collection mappings and an audit-export check above the current public graph.

example.vendor:collection.purpose: Map product evidence to the public question; no query is executed.

nodes.label: Cloud: Audit export check
nodes.text: Does the retained cloud audit export include source provenance and collection coverage?

example.vendor:criteria.yes: The retained export identifies its origin, integrity basis, interval, and collection gaps.
example.vendor:criteria.no: The examined export demonstrably lacks a required provenance or coverage field.
example.vendor:criteria.unknown: The export or its collection basis is unavailable or unresolved.

extensions.example.vendor:purpose: An additional product-layer evidence check, separate from the public graph routes.

metadata.name: Example organization · cloud review v1.1
metadata.description: Local policy context and a review question above the current public graph.

example.organization:policy.purpose: Policy context is separate from the public technical finding.

nodes.label: Cloud: Organization review
nodes.text: Does the applicable organization policy require review of this supported cloud resource change?

example.organization:criteria.yes: The named policy version and bound resource parameters require review.
example.organization:criteria.no: The named policy version and bound parameters exclude this change from review.
example.organization:criteria.unknown: The applicable policy, resource scope, or required parameters are unresolved.

extensions.example.organization:purpose: An organization-layer policy question; it does not change the public technical finding or execute an escalation.
